title: bnm.json
description: Configuration file for bnm, a task runner for multi-directory projects.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation and autocompletion.

name.description: Project name. Exposed to task processes as PROJECT_NAME.

version.description: Project version. Exposed to task processes as PROJECT_VERSION.

directories.description: Named directory entries usable in scripts, filters, and bnm exec. Values are paths.

oneOf.description: Relative path to the directory. Must not be empty.
Legacy form with an alias usable as an alternative name.

alias.description: Alternative short name for filters and bnm exec.

path.description: Relative path to the directory. Must not be empty.

oneOf.description: Run this command in every configured directory (parallel). Must not be empty.
Detailed form: mode, dependencies, concurrency, and tasks.

mode.description: How tasks are run. Defaults to parallel.

dependsOn.description: Scripts to run to completion before this one. Cycles are rejected.

maxParallel.description: Maximum number of tasks running at once in parallel mode. 0 or omitted means unlimited.

watch.description: Run in watch mode by default: rerun when files in task directories change. Only honored when this script is the one invoked; --no-watch overrides it.

oneOf.description: Tasks keyed by task name. The key doubles as the directory unless the task sets "dir".
Legacy array form with an explicit dir per task.
Task map. Keys are task names and double as the directory (a directories name, alias, or path; '.' for the project root) unless the task sets "dir".

command.description: Command to run: a string, or an object keyed by OS (windows, mac, linux, default).

env.description: Extra environment variables for this task. Override the shared environment.

timeout.description: Per-attempt time limit as a Go duration string (e.g. "30s", "2m"). The task is killed when it elapses.

retries.description: How many times to rerun the task after a failure. 0 or omitted means no retries.

watch.description: Restart just this task when files in its directory change; other tasks keep running. Requires parallel mode. Ignored when the whole script runs in watch mode.

taskValue.description: A command, or a task object with dir/env/timeout/retries.

dir.description: Directory the command runs in: a directories name, alias, or path ('.' for the project root). Defaults to the task's key.
Directory key from directories, or a path. Omit or use '.' for the project root.
